Question
========
A CUDA version gives a 25x improvement, the best SIMD version 5x. A GPU costs about 700 kg CO2e to manufacture and consumes about 80 W.

Base parameters: a non-optimized version supports 100 req/s per server, the target is 100 000 req/s, a server costs 3000 kg CO2e and is replaced every 5 years, a normal server consumes 150 W, electricity in Belgium is 165 g CO2e/kWh.

What is the total CO2e over 5 years of 365 days for both versions, ignoring scope 1?

Solution
========
Five years is 43800 hours.

GPU version: 100 x 25 = 2500 req/s per server, so 40 servers.
  Manufacturing: 40 x (3000 + 700) = 148 000 kg.
  Power: 40 x (150 + 80) = 9200 W, so 402 960 kWh, times 165 g = 66 488 kg.
  Total: about 214 500 kg CO2e.

SIMD version: 100 x 5 = 500 req/s per server, so 200 servers.
  Manufacturing: 200 x 3000 = 600 000 kg.
  Power: 200 x 150 = 30 000 W, so 1 314 000 kWh, times 165 g = 216 810 kg.
  Total: about 816 800 kg CO2e.

The GPU version is about 3.8 times better, and again manufacturing is the dominant term, so what matters is the number of machines, not the extra draw of the GPU.
